slide.heading: How does information move?
points: Sensory information enters the sensory register.
Attention selects information and transfers it to short-term memory (STM).
Maintenance rehearsal keeps information in STM; prolonged rehearsal can transfer it to long-term memory (LTM).
Retrieval brings information from LTM back into STM.
